title: Sources: National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross is leaving now to let the White House get a successor confirmed before Democrats take the Senate in January (Axios)
summary: Axios: Sources: National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross is leaving now to let the White House get a successor confirmed before Democrats take the Senate in January — The White House named Kirsten A. Davies to be its new national cyber director Thursday as President Trump overhauls his AI team, Axios has learned.
